latest.name: GitHub Copilot Free
latest.short_verdict: A useful free coding assistant with 2,000 monthly inline completions and GitHub web/mobile chat. Chat and agent credits are limited, and GitHub does not publish a fixed numeric Free credit allowance.
latest.what_it_does: Provides inline code completions in supported IDEs and Copilot Chat on GitHub.com and GitHub Mobile. It can answer programming questions and explain code in repository, file, issue, and pull-request contexts. Copilot Free uses automatic model selection.
latest.why_try_it: It combines code suggestions with repository-aware Q&A in the GitHub workflow. The browser chat is usable without installing an IDE, and the official GitHub Android app includes Copilot Chat. It is useful for code explanations, small snippets, and targeted debugging, while keeping a human review step.
latest.free_tier: Copilot Free costs $0 and includes up to 2,000 inline code completions per month. Chat and agent usage is limited through GitHub AI Credits; GitHub's current public plan documentation does not publish a fixed numeric Free credit allowance or a guaranteed chat-message count. Free users can use Copilot Chat on GitHub.com and GitHub Mobile. Model selection is automatic.
latest.limits: The 2,000 monthly inline-completion cap applies. Chat and agent usage is limited and the exact Free credit quantity is not published, so do not rely on older references to a fixed 50-chat allowance. Copilot Free does not include Copilot in the cloud (the autonomous cloud coding agent); GitHub documents that feature for paid plans. Free is for individual developers who do not already have Copilot access through an organization or enterprise.
latest.signup_pakistan: A personal GitHub account is required; no paid Copilot subscription is needed. Copilot Free is restricted to individual developers who do not already receive Copilot through an organization or enterprise. Pakistan is not named among the destinations restricted by GitHub's current trade-controls policy, but a live Pakistan signup and account-level eligibility test was not performed.
latest.quality_evidence: A GitHub-led controlled study published in 2022 randomly assigned 95 professional developers to write a JavaScript HTTP server with or without Copilot. The Copilot group completed the task 55% faster on average (1 hour 11 minutes versus 2 hours 41 minutes), with 78% versus 70% completing it. This is an older vendor-led study on one bounded task and an earlier Copilot version, not a benchmark of today's Free plan. Community feedback after the 2026 credit changes is mixed; at least one user reported exhausting chat and inline quota within days, an anecdotal warning rather than a measured Free-plan quota.
latest.android_status: Official GitHub Android app verified. GitHub's documentation confirms Copilot Chat is available in GitHub Mobile on Android. This is the official GitHub app with Copilot Chat built in, not a separate standalone Copilot app. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not independently tested.
latest.optional_upgrade_note: Optional paid Copilot plans add larger AI-credit allowances, model selection, and cloud-agent features; they are not part of this free recommendation.
